disposition: full assignment; incident named the Haven Fire
summary: Crews went out on a single report of a large brush fire on the foothills north of Lake Ming that was growing. The call went out as a full response, with a helicopter, air attack, water tenders, air-to-ground coordination and several engine, patrol and battalion assignments, and crews designated the incident the Haven Fire on the tactical channel. Units were directed onto side roads looking for access to the top of the hill.

disposition: crew committed; access made through a gate on the Chevron lease
summary: A fire was reported on the south side of the river in an area of about an eighth of an acre, and a crew reported it was making access through a gate on the Chevron lease. A second unit committed to the same fire a minute later.

disposition: units sent; asked to confirm the man was struck by a vehicle
summary: A caller reported a man lying in the roadway who was not moving, and units on the call were asked to confirm whether the man had told them he had been hit by a vehicle.

disposition: one person out of the vehicle
summary: Rescue, engine and truck crews responded with CHP on a report of a possible vehicle versus a pole, and one person was already out of the vehicle when the first crews arrived.
Engine and battalion units were sent for a fire burning in a backyard, two to three feet from a house and threatening the structure.
A unit was sent for a report of illegal burning along Highway 119 west of Bakersfield.
A caller reported shots heard in a field area, with people living in the field and drinking there.
Crews were sent for a gas leak. One engine reported it could handle, and the rest of the assignment was cancelled.

area: 700 block of South Tulare Street, Bakersfield
summary: Officers were sent for a disturbance with several people yelling in the background and several people speaking Spanish.

area: Cottonwood Road at Kennelly Road, Bakersfield
disposition: units moved in to break up the group
summary: Units at Cottonwood Road and Kennelly Road reported they were breaking up a group of racers in the area.

disposition: unit assigned; also given to the Los Angeles center
summary: A tan pickup was reported swerving and running at fluctuating speeds on northbound Interstate 5.

area: northbound Interstate 5 south of Highway 138, Kern County
summary: A white Hyundai sedan was reported moving in and out of its lane on northbound Interstate 5 south of Highway 138.
The next available unit was sent to a domestic call where the caller reported three children were home alone.
